classification.difficultyReason: Add numerators while retaining the common denominator, represent the sum by shading supplied equal-part diagrams, and simplify 9/12 where appropriate.

content.prompt: Add and subtract these fractions using the diagrams.

spec.description: Three equal circles divided into quarters, in a horizontal addition equation. The first upper-right quarter and both upper quarters of the second circle are filled; the result circle is empty.
spec.mathematics: One quarter plus two quarters; shade the result circle.
spec.answerVisibility: Given fills visible; result shading absent.

answer.worked:
Shade 3 of the 4 equal sectors in the result circle.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{1}{4}+\frac{2}{4}&=\frac{1+2}{4}\\&=\frac{3}{4}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Complete addition model with three quarters of the result circle filled.
spec.answerVisibility: Result shading visible only in the solution.

spec.description: Three equal circles divided into eighths. Four upper sectors of the first and the sector between the rightward and upper-right radii of the second are filled; the third is empty.
spec.mathematics: Four eighths plus one eighth; shade the result circle.
spec.answerVisibility: Given fills visible; result shading absent.

answer.worked:
Shade 5 of the 8 equal sectors in the result circle.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{4}{8}+\frac{1}{8}&=\frac{4+1}{8}\\&=\frac{5}{8}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Complete addition model with five eighths of the result circle filled.
spec.answerVisibility: Result shading visible only in the solution.

spec.description: Three equal circles divided into fifths. Three contiguous sectors across the upper and left portions of the first and the upper-right sector of the second are filled; the third is empty.
spec.mathematics: Three fifths plus one fifth; shade the result circle.
spec.answerVisibility: Given fills visible; result shading absent.

answer.worked:
Shade 4 of the 5 equal sectors in the result circle.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{3}{5}+\frac{1}{5}&=\frac{3+1}{5}\\&=\frac{4}{5}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Complete addition model with four fifths of the result circle filled.
spec.answerVisibility: Result shading visible only in the solution.

spec.description: Three equal circles divided into twelfths. Seven contiguous sectors across the top and extending into the lower-left of the first and two adjacent upper-right sectors of the second are filled; the third is empty.
spec.mathematics: Seven twelfths plus two twelfths; shade the result circle.
spec.answerVisibility: Given fills visible; result shading absent.

answer.worked:
Shade 9 of the 12 equal sectors in the result circle.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{7}{12}+\frac{2}{12}&=\frac{7+2}{12}\\&=\frac{9}{12}\\&=\frac{3}{4}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Three equal four-column, three-row arrays in a horizontal addition equation. First: all of column 1 and the top cell of column 2 filled. Second: all of column 3 and the middle and bottom cells of column 2 filled. Third: empty.
